name: Ctenophores (comb jellies)
description: Gelatinous estuarine predators dominated in the mesohaline Bay by the comb jelly Mnemiopsis leidyi. Functional group aggregating ctenophore taxa as a single source compartment; they eat zooplankton, ciliates and suspended detritus and are in turn eaten by sea nettles. Reported biomass (metrics.biomass) is the annual mean in mgC/m2.
